ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark-grey to black pixels across 85% of the surface area, with localized high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated at the distal lobe tips and in scattered circular scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary pigmentation is a contiguous dark grey. High-contrast white mottling and irregular geometric blobs are localized at the distal 15% of the left lobe and distal 10% of the right lobe. Mid-intensity grey rings and spots are distributed across the central ventral region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 30 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entirety of the trailing edge. Pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys varies between 4 and 12 pixels, with the most irregular and jagged segments located on the outer distal margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, transitioning into a slight concave taper towards the distal tips, creating a broad wing-like profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of circular white-on-black pixel configurations at the distal tips. Distinct ring-like scars with low-intensity centers are visible on the lower central region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three prominent, parallel, high-intensity white linear scratches detected on the right lobe, oriented at a roughly 45-degree diagonal angle towards the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular indentation and jagged tissue loss on the outermost trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating physical trauma or amputation of the tip margin.
